article.story: RADFORD, Va. -- — Dennis Parker Jr.'s 53 points helped lead Radford over Coppin State 107-77 on Sunday. Parker made 10 3-pointers for the Highlanders (5-7). He averages about 16 points and had a previous season high of 27 points. His 53 points are the individual high in Division I this season. Lukas Walls scored 15 points and added three steals. Tyson Brown shot 4 of 4 from the field and 6 of 8 from the free-throw line to finish with 14 points. Hussain Williams led the Eagles (2-12) in scoring, finishing with 19 points and two steals. Hassan Perkins added 15 points for Coppin State. Taj Thweatt had nine points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
